newsitem.title: UK: UK's BBC denies report of Flextech deal.
newsitem.headline: UK's BBC denies report of Flextech deal.

text.p: The UK's BBC has denied a report in the Sunday Times newspaper that it had signed an agreement with cable and satellite programming company Flextech Plc to launch six subscription TV channels.
A spokesman for the state broadcaster confirmed it had been in discussion with Flextech and negotiations were continuing.
"But, we have, emphatically, not signed heads of agreement, as reported in The Sunday Times," he said.

Flextech, which is controlled by America's biggest cable TV operator, Tele-Communications Inc has been wooing the BBC, as has Satellite broadcaster BSkyB,, in which Rupert Murdoch's News Corp is the largest shareholder.
